synopsis: Chapter 11 places MathWorks Vehicle Dynamics Blockset and Simscape in the vehicle and machine dynamics, terrain and soil tool category [f8357]. The glossary describes them as road-heritage dynamics tools with articulated steering available since R2025a [f15975]. Chapter 11 further reports that Vehicle Dynamics Blockset, Simscape and off-road kinematics provide dynamics and controller models, including articulated steering, operating closed-loop in Simulink R2026b [f8599]. However, high-detail soil deformation is not a primary strength of this tool combination, qualifying its inclusion in the terrain and soil category [f8600, f8357].

relations.note: Adds controller models, off-road kinematics and closed-loop Simulink R2026b operation to articulated-steering capability.
Adds road heritage and an R2025a articulated-steering milestone to the tool-category listing.
Specifies dynamics and controller capabilities behind the broad category listing.
Qualifies terrain and soil categorization: high-detail soil deformation is not a primary strength.
